name: request_goal
description: Proposes to the user that the task be escalated to a full '/goal' workflow, when it is too complex, multidisciplinary, or requires multi-phase planning with a supervisor and specialist roles. Requires the user's explicit approval.

goal.description: The complete, detailed objective for the Goal Orchestrator to plan and execute.

reason.description: A clear rationale for why escalating to a /goal workflow is advisable instead of proceeding as a single agent (e.g. need for a security audit, multidisciplinary changes, supervisor review).
